candidates.title: Invoice paperwork check for administrators

demandEvidence.chore: Handle invoices and check supporting documents against contracts and orders.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Hantera fakturor och kontrollera underlag mot avtal och beställningar

ease.reason: A fictional invoice and order can test field extraction; the template lists invoice extraction and logging, not the employer's process.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: professional offices may value invoice preparation; the vacancy proves only paid human work, not AI-tool demand.

feasibility.reason: A two-week demo can extract invoice number, amount and due date for a clerk to compare; contract matching is unsupported by the template.

autonomy.reason: The listed template monitors PDFs, extracts fields and logs them; a person must verify values and perform contract or order decisions.

evidence.reason: The fresh notice names invoice checks; the template listing describes extraction and logging, but neither proves actual use or AI demand.

candidates.reason: Assessed a narrow fictional-document extraction and clerk-review experiment. Mean 5.4 is below 6; the notice does not specify rules, and the reference does not establish reconciliation capability.

candidates.title: Work-order and invoice admin check

demandEvidence.chore: Ensure work orders are current and correctly closed, quality-check supporting documents, and handle invoicing and financial follow-up.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: säkerställa att arbetsorder är uppdaterade och avslutas korrekt kvalitetssäkra underlag och skapa ett effektivt faktureringsflöde hantera fakturering och bidra till ekonomisk uppföljning

ease.reason: A mock invoice extraction can be tried from the listed template, but work-order status rules are not supplied.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: service offices may value billing support; this notice establishes a human role, not demand for an AI service.

feasibility.reason: A document summary is testable with synthetic inputs, but work-order closure and financial follow-up rules are unspecified.

autonomy.reason: Invoice extraction and logging are described in the template; a person must check records and decide whether orders can close.

evidence.reason: The notice lists work-order, document and billing chores; the template lists invoice extraction, without showing this workflow in use.

candidates.reason: Assessed the listed bounded document-summary experiment; mean 5.0 is below 6. Its invoice workflow overlaps the other assessed notice, and the reference does not support work-order decisions.
